headline: Pakistan beat Maldives 3-0 at the National Football Stadium in Dhaka on Sunday in the 2026 SAFF Championship, with a McKeal Abdullah penalty and a first-half brace from Najeebullah Bettani, moving closer to the semi-finals, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Dhaka mein Najeebullah Bettani ke 2 goal, semi-final qareeb

caption:
Pakistan football team ne Maldives ko 3-0 se hara diya! ⚽
Dawn ke mutabiq Sunday ko Dhaka ke National Football Stadium mein SAFF Championship ke Group B match mein McKeal Abdullah ne 4th minute mein penalty par goal kiya aur Najeebullah Bettani ne first half mein 2 goal kiye. Yeh tournament mein Pakistan ki pehli jeet hai, aur team semi-final ke qareeb pohanch gayi hai.
Kya Pakistan semi-final mein pohanchega? Comment mein batayein 👇
